title: 布兰德·小灯笼之夜
description: 布兰德保留炭色面容与柔和火焰轮廓，穿厚实外衣，安静欣赏纸灯笼而不燃烧周围物件。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Brand is an elemental adult humanoid with a charcoal-dark face, glowing amber eyes, and warm orange fissure-like light across his recognizable fire-touched form. Render the flames as soft contained candle-shaped wisps around his head and hands, without damage or distress. Add a fully covering dark coat, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots while retaining his ember silhouette.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a stone courtyard seat and admires a small paper lantern resting safely on a separate low table, hands folded in his lap. The lantern's gentle golden glow harmonizes with his contained ember light without any object catching fire. A few rounded evening clouds and a quiet wall keep the moment calm and friendly.
art_direction.palette: soft ember orange, charcoal violet, honey yellow, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
